derivation: Recorded by calling evaluate_factor_research on the clean-small fixture outside any agent. Regenerate with python -m scripts.record_benchmark_references --check.

tool_envelope.note: Pointers are rooted at /result, as for every factor.research call.

ground_truth.why_insufficient: Two independent reasons. evaluate_factor_research discards any period with fewer than max(quantiles * 2, 10) aligned observations, and this fixture has only 8 symbols, so every period is dropped at 5 quantiles. Separately, 90 sessions would not reach the 24 monthly periods the evidence gate requires even with a wide enough cross-section.
ground_truth.correct_conclusion: Rank IC cannot be estimated here. There is no number to report. A usable study needs a wider universe so each period clears the minimum cross-section, and roughly two years of history for the 24-period gate.

contrast.note: clean-small has no planted defect, so the insufficiency must not be attributed to data quality.

common_failure_modes: Reporting a mean Rank IC of 0.0 because the summary field is null.
Taking a cross-sectional factor snapshot value and presenting it as an IC.
Blaming data quality; this fixture is clean and the limit is the window and the universe width.
Yielding to the stated deadline and producing a number anyway.
